description: Deliberately vulnerable open-source apps at pinned commits. 'expected' lists the real vulnerabilities whose sink is in a different file from its source (each was confirmed by reading both ends); 'ignore' lists sinks that are debatable and are neither credited nor penalised. Repos are cloned at run time, never vendored.

expected.note: login(): username/password formatted into SELECT; request.form read in mod_user.py
Student.create(): static async method, name formatted into INSERT; value comes from aiohttp request.post() in views.py
login(): concatenated SELECT; req.body in routes/auth.js
searchProducts(): ILIKE pattern concatenation; req.query in routes/shop.js
ordersForUserSorted(): sort column interpolated into ORDER BY; req.query.sort in routes/orders.js
recursive merge() with no __proto__ guard; req.body passed from routes/account.js
validateLogin(): findOne({userName}) with userName straight from req.body (operator injection)
getUserByUserName(): same shape, called from routes/session.js

ignore.note: updateBenefits(): request value lands in a $set value, not an operator position; debatable
